claims.evidence: Witness only reports the keyboard appearance/branding on the control panel; no proof of power-on, sound test, or full functionality.

claims.claim: It is used but working perfectly well.
claims.evidence: Witness did not report condition specifics (scratches/cracks/missing keys) or any functional test; only visual features were observed.

risks.risk: Not actually working (dead keys, faulty buttons, no sound, or screen not functioning).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, LCD turning on, pressing multiple keys across the range, and playing/producing sound through both speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty (worst-case) until a working demo is shown.

risks.risk: LCD issues (dead pixels, flicker, or contrast problems).
risks.proof: Close-up clip of the LCD during operation with a clear view of the screen while navigating menus/settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD may be defective (worst-case) until the screen is clearly shown working.

risks.risk: Speaker or audio quality problems (crackling, low volume, one speaker dead).
risks.proof: Audio test clip playing notes/chords at low and higher volume, showing sound from both left and right speaker ends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as speakers may be weak/defective (worst-case) until both sides are confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or power adapter not included.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the exact items included, especially the power adapter (label/voltage) and any stand/pedal/manuals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter/accessories may be missing (worst-case) until inclusion is confirmed.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (scratches, cracks, loose/missing keys, damaged speaker grilles).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of: keybed/keys (front and underside if possible), speaker grilles, and the control panel for cracks/loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic/structural wear (worst-case) until condition is clearly documented.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (photo text not fully readable; could be a different PSR variant).
risks.proof: Photo of the full model name/number from the control panel and/or the label on the back/bottom showing the exact PSR model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the model may be different/uncertain (worst-case) until the exact model is confirmed.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing LCD working and a full-range key test (left to right) with audible sound.
Audio demo showing both speakers working (play and pan/alternate sounds if possible).
Close-up photos of the LCD for dead pixels and the speaker grilles for damage.
Photos/clip of included items: power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manuals/box (if any).
Clear photo of the exact model number (control panel text fully readable and/or back/bottom label).
response.reason: The witness confirms it appears to be a Yamaha PSR-series keyboard, but there is no verified evidence of working condition (power, sound, LCD, keys) or exact model number. Without a working demo and clear model confirmation, pricing would be too uncertain.
